findings.failure_path: A model calls tool-search during a user turn, but the matching schema may only be added at a turn boundary. It therefore cannot call the discovered tool during the active loop; injecting it immediately instead violates the stated cache rule.
findings.smallest_fix: Define the boundary precisely as the next model invocation/cache breakpoint within the same loop, and retain every definition referenced by that loop's history.

findings.failure_path: The unconditional instruction to never rewrite earlier turns conflicts with the existing requirement to compact overflowing context and can retain revoked, sensitive, or newly unauthorized material solely to preserve cache hits.
findings.smallest_fix: Limit append-only behavior to ordinary turns; require a new cache generation and baseline reset for compaction, privacy deletion, authorization changes, safety updates, or other mandatory invalidation.

findings.failure_path: An implementation can keep private data, untrusted content, and an external channel, select context minimization as the named pattern, and pass the rule even though injected content can still influence an exfiltrating action.
findings.smallest_fix: Require an enforceable and tested invariant showing which capability or influence edge is absent; allow context minimization only when sensitive context is unavailable at tool-selection and action time.

findings.failure_path: Counting only order-consistent pairwise judgments removes precisely the samples exhibiting position bias, shrinking the denominator and potentially producing an artificially high score used for rollout.
findings.smallest_fix: Report the inconsistency rate and retain inconsistent pairs in the denominator as failures, ties, or predeclared abstentions; never silently exclude them.

findings.failure_path: The required size, impact-chain, routing, R0, and check-ccl-skills results cannot be independently verified from this bounded packet because the review ledger and stderr are empty and the profile's evidence statements are explicitly untrusted claims.
findings.smallest_fix: Include non-empty, candidate-bound gate evidence recording the exact commands, base and candidate SHAs, exit statuses, and relevant stdout, including the completed make/test result.
